title: WPCRL/1130/2015 of Ravi Shankar Chaube Vs State Of Uttarakhand AND ANOTHER

paras.text:
WPCRL No. 1130 of 2015
Hon'ble Alok Singh, J.
None is present for the petitioner.
Writ petition was filed on 10.09.2015 with
defect.
Vide order dated 11.09.2015, petitioner was
required to remove defects; thereafter, vide order dated
14.09.2015 again petitioner was given liberty to
remove the defects; vide order dated 15.09.2015, this
Court was further pleased to grant time to remove
defects.
Petitioner has not removed the defects.
Writ petition is dismissed for non-prosecution.
(Alok Singh, J.)
 02.11.2015
Deepak
